purpose: Define the canonical library of pattern signatures used by Beast System 3.0 to detect misconduct, corruption, retaliation, systemic failures, rights violations, and infrastructure risks.

corruption_signatures.description: Patterns indicating favoritism, irregular access, or misuse of authority.

signatures.name: Irregular Access Pattern
signatures.pattern: Repeated access to restricted systems without documented justification.

signatures.name: Exception Frequency Spike
signatures.pattern: Unusual number of exceptions granted to the same actor or group.

signatures.name: Relational Favor Pattern
signatures.pattern: Repeated approvals or benefits directed toward connected individuals.

retaliation_signatures.description: Patterns indicating retaliation against civilians following complaints or reports.

signatures.name: Adverse Action After Complaint
signatures.pattern: Negative municipal action within 3 cycles of a civilian complaint.

signatures.name: Communication Tone Shift
signatures.pattern: Sudden shift to hostile, dismissive, or coercive communication after a report.

signatures.name: Service Denial Pattern
signatures.pattern: Repeated denial of services to a civilian who filed a complaint.

bias_and_disparate_impact_signatures.description: Patterns indicating discrimination or disproportionate harm.

signatures.name: Disparate Enforcement Pattern
signatures.pattern: Higher enforcement frequency against a specific demographic group.

signatures.name: Unequal Resource Allocation
signatures.pattern: Resource distribution consistently favoring one group over others.

signatures.name: Patterned Denial of Accommodations
signatures.pattern: Repeated failure to provide disability or language accommodations.

documentation_integrity_signatures.description: Patterns indicating tampering, missing records, or audit trail corruption.

signatures.name: Missing Entry Cluster
signatures.pattern: Multiple missing documentation entries within a short time window.

signatures.name: Hash Chain Break
signatures.pattern: Sequential hash mismatch indicating potential tampering.

signatures.name: Custody Irregularity Pattern
signatures.pattern: Undocumented access or transfer of sensitive records.

infrastructure_and_operational_signature.description: Patterns indicating system instability, failure risk, or operational degradation.

signatures.name: Failure Cascade Pattern
signatures.pattern: Multiple subsystems showing failure_risk above 0.70 simultaneously.

signatures.name: Continuity Degradation
signatures.pattern: continuity_score dropping below 0.50 across two cycles.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification and relational mapping.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Primary engine for signature detection and pattern scoring.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for rights-impact evaluation and escalation logic.
